issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Skydive
products.tagline: Build cloud agents that work across your tools
products.summaryZh: 构建跨工具协作的云端智能体
products.descriptionZh: 构建云代理同事，承担你在现有工具中的真实多步骤工作。描述你期望的结果，Skydive在几分钟内创建可工作的代理。无需编码、无需提示工程、无需工作流配置。Skydive代理驻留在你的技术栈中，执行可重复任务，并随时间变得更加精准。
products.description: Build cloud agent coworkers that take on real, multi-step work across the tools you already use. Describe the outcome you want, and Skydive creates a working agent in minutes. No code, no prompt engineering, no workflow wiring required. Skydive agents live in your stack, execute repeatable work, and get sharper over time.

products.name: Enter Pro
products.tagline: The AI-native platform to build and scale your apps
products.summaryZh: 构建并扩展应用的原生AI平台
products.descriptionZh: 经营业务所需的不只是代码。Enter Pro是一个AI原生平台，能将想法转化为可运行的产品。在同一个连续工作空间中，规划、构建、预览、发布并扩展应用、网站和定制AI代理。模型、数据库、认证、托管、支付、分析和本地化功能均已内置——让团队能够交付为真实业务而构建的软件，而不仅仅是原型。
products.description: Building what runs a business takes more than code. Enter Pro is the AI-native platform that turns an idea into a working product. Plan, build, preview, launch, and scale apps, websites, and custom AI agents in one continuous workspace. Models, databases, authentication, hosting, payments, analytics, and localization are built in—so teams can ship software built for real business, not just prototypes.

products.name: Lenz
products.tagline: Independent, multi-model fact-checking API for AI workflows
products.summaryZh: 面向AI工作流的独立多模型事实核查API
products.descriptionZh: Lenz是一款面向无法承受幻觉风险产品的AI事实核查API。它从任何文本中提取可验证的声明，然后逐一核查：搜索独立来源、运行多模型辩论，并经由审查小组路由——返回带评分的裁决，所有来源、论据和步骤均可见。大多数AI工具仅凭记忆给出单一模型的最佳猜测。Lenz确保没有任何单一模型的盲点主导结论。提供API和MCP两种形式。可在lenz.io/ph免费试用。
products.description: Lenz is an AI fact-checking API for products that cannot afford to hallucinate. It extracts verifiable claims from any text, then checks each one: searching independent sources, running multi-model debate, and routing through a review panel — returning a scored verdict with every source, argument, and step visible. Most AI tools give you one model's best guess from memory. Lenz ensures no single model's blind spots drive the conclusion. Available as API and MCP. Try it free at lenz.io/ph

products.name: Speko
products.tagline: OpenRouter for Voice
products.summaryZh: OpenRouter 语音版
products.descriptionZh: 一个API即可实现语音转文字、语言模型与文字转语音，并附带公开基准测试及运行时可用性。
products.description: One API for speech-to-text, language models, and text-to-speech, with public benchmarks beside runtime availability.

products.name: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe
products.tagline: Our most precise speech-to-text model yet
products.summaryZh: 我们迄今最精准的语音转文字模型。
products.descriptionZh: 我们最新的语音转文字模型，专为精准智能的实时转录而设计。
products.description: Our latest speech-to-text model designed for precise and intelligent real-time transcription.

products.name: Traccia
products.tagline: Finally, a vendor-neutral AI Agent Control Plane.
products.summaryZh: 终于，一个厂商中立的AI智能体控制平面。
products.descriptionZh: Traccia 是一个供应商中立的 AI Agent 控制平面，专为在生产环境中运行自主代理的团队而设计。观察代理行为，评估性能，通过策略和运行时控制来治理操作，并保留可审计的事件轨迹。基于开放的、开发者优先的 SDK 和 OpenTelemetry 构建，Traccia 跨模型、框架和现有可观测性堆栈工作，使团队能够控制其代理，而无需受限于单一 AI 供应商。
products.description: Traccia is a vendor-neutral AI Agent Control Plane built for teams running autonomous agents in production. Observe agent behavior, evaluate performance, govern actions with policies and runtime controls, and maintain an auditable trail of what happened. Built with an open, developer-first SDK and OpenTelemetry, Traccia works across models, frameworks, and existing observability stacks—so teams can control their agents without being locked into a single AI vendor.

products.name: GitNexus (Akon Labs)
products.tagline: The open-source kernel for coding agents
products.summaryZh: 开源内核，用于编码代理
products.descriptionZh: GitNexus（GitHub 45k 星标）是一个知识图谱内核，将你组织中的所有代码库统一为单一事实来源，供编码代理查询。它把你的代码解析为确定性图谱，因此代理能获得精确的调用者、导入和影响，而非嵌入猜测，覆盖你运行的所有仓库和 SCM。在我们的公开基准测试（https://www.akonlabs.com/benchmarks）中，连接 GitNexus 后，编码代理运行成本降低 51%。它通过 MCP 与任何代理兼容。
products.description: GitNexus (45k Github stars) is a Knowledge Graph Kernel that unifies every codebase in your org into one source of truth your coding agents can query. It resolves your code into a deterministic graph, so agents get exact callers, imports, and impact instead of embedding guesses, across every repo and SCM you run. On our public benchmark (https://www.akonlabs.com/benchmarks), coding agent runs 51% cheaper with GitNexus connected. It works with any agent over MCP.

products.name: SpacebarX
products.tagline: A keyboard-first outliner for notes, tasks and projects
products.summaryZh: 一款以键盘操作为主的笔记、任务与项目管理大纲工具。
products.descriptionZh: SpacebarX 是一款以键盘为先、本地优先的大纲工具，适用于笔记、任务、写作、Markdown、代码和项目。通过键盘快速捕捉和整理内容，内联添加日期，让“今日”视图汇集需要关注的事项。在工作区中搜索，同时保持每条笔记的上下文。它支持离线使用，并通过您控制的云文件夹进行同步。永久免费。Pro 版增加可视化视图、保存的搜索、加密文档、版本恢复、日历、上传和 BYOK AI 功能。
products.description: SpacebarX is a keyboard-first, local-first outliner for notes, tasks, writing, markdown, code, and projects. Capture and organize from the keyboard, add dates inline, and let Today collect what needs attention. Search across your workspace while keeping every note in context. It works offline and syncs through a cloud folder you control. Free forever. Pro adds visual views, saved searches, encrypted documents, version restore, Calendar, uploads, and BYOK AI.

products.name: Kira Community
products.tagline: Curate moments with #hashtag
products.summaryZh: 用#话题标签记录精彩瞬间
products.descriptionZh: Kira最初是一款用于创作美好事物的工具：将照片或提示词转化为肖像、电影感画面和视频。如今，它也成为分享这些作品的地方。Kira社区让你的创作化为瞬间。用#话题标签标记作品，将其保留在个人主页，并浏览围绕人们真正关心的主题构建的信息流；以及那些与你一同关心这些主题的人。这是Kira从工具迈向社区的第一步。精心策划你的瞬间，与懂你的人分享。
products.description: Kira began as a tool for making beautiful things: turn a photo or a prompt into portraits, cinematic shots, videos. Now it's a place to share them, too. Kira Community is where your creations become moments. Tag your work with #hashtags, keep it on your profile, and browse a feed built around the themes people actually care about; and the people who care about them with you. This is Kira's first step from a tool to a community. Curate your moments, and share them with people who get it.

products.name: Pluto
products.tagline: Your professional profile is now an AI agent
products.summaryZh: 你的专业档案现在是一个AI智能体。
products.descriptionZh: Pluto是一款AI语音代理，能在10分钟内了解你的故事，并让你被合适的人和AI代理发现。大多数简介将你简化为头衔和关键词。Pluto则捕捉它们遗漏的部分，从你的擅长领域到你的下一步目标，以及你的最佳工作方式。它将这种理解转化为一个动态的职业简介，随着你的变化而保持更新，更全面地展现你的真实面貌。
products.description: Pluto is an AI voice agent that learns your story in 10 minutes and makes you discoverable to the right people and AI agents. Most profiles reduce you to titles and keywords. Pluto learns what they miss, from what you are great at to what you want next and how you work best. It turns that understanding into a living professional profile that stays current as you do and represents the fuller picture of who you are.

products.name: Wondering Canvas
products.tagline: Visual ChatGPT in Parallel
products.summaryZh: 并行版Visual ChatGPT
products.descriptionZh: AI聊天线程的可视化画布，助你并行理解任何事物。以问题开启聊天线程，获得带交互式图表的解释，而非冗长文字。将任意关键术语或句子拆分为独立线程，在同一画布中提出相关问题，并跟随建议的后续问题。深入探索每个细节，同时将你的思路整理在一处。
products.description: A visual canvas of AI chat threads for understanding anything in parallel. Start a chat thread with a question and get an explanation with interactive diagrams instead of a wall of text. Spin off any key term or sentence into its own thread, ask related questions in the same canvas, and follow suggested next questions. Explore every rabbit hole while keeping your thinking organized in one place.

products.name: Savvy
products.tagline: An assistant that whispers what to say during a meeting
products.summaryZh: 会议中轻声提示该说什么的助手
products.descriptionZh: Savvy是一款macOS会议助手，基于您自己的文档而非开放网络。指向一个文件夹，它会为每位客户构建带版本控制的简报。会议期间保持安静，仅在三种情况下发言：对方提出了您简报能回答的问题、有人越过了您设定的红线，或您按下了“建议”键。每张卡片均注明来源。文档、索引和转录内容保留在您的Mac上；仅摘录和音频流会传出。适用于Apple Silicon，macOS 13及以上版本。开源，MIT许可。
products.description: Savvy is a macOS meeting assistant grounded in your own documents, not the open web. Point it at a folder and it builds a versioned brief per client. In the meeting it stays quiet, then speaks up for exactly three reasons: they asked a question your brief answers, someone crossed a red line you set, or you pressed Advice. Every card cites its source. Documents, indexes and transcripts stay on your Mac; only excerpts and the audio stream leave. Apple Silicon, macOS 13+. Open source, MIT.

products.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
products.tagline: The open-weight preview of Qwen4
products.summaryZh: Qwen4的开源权重预览版
products.descriptionZh: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next是一款125B参数的多模态MoE模型，仅6B激活参数，并围绕QSA、门控残差、N-gram嵌入和Muon构建了新架构。其开放权重让外界得以提前窥见Qwen为Qwen4所构建的架构方向。
products.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a 125B multimodal MoE with only 6B active parameters and a new architecture built around QSA, Gated Residual, N-gram embeddings, and Muon. Its open weights give an early look at the architecture Qwen is building toward Qwen4.

products.name: Ojin
products.tagline: Talk to an AI Agent with a real face and voice, in real time
products.summaryZh: 与具有真实面孔和声音的AI代理实时对话
products.descriptionZh: 人类AI代理拥有真实的面孔和声音，进行实时对话而非轮流交流。可以打断其话语、让其话说到一半停下、或在其说话时插话，端点检测依然稳定。设置只需一张静态照片、一个角色设定和一个声音。无需动作捕捉、录制会话或脚本。单一API背后有两种面部模型：Portrait用于规模，Presence用于表现力。两者均可集成到Pipecat和LiveKit中。试着打断它。大多数演示无法经受这种考验，而这正是评判此产品的最快方式。
products.description: Human AI Agents have a real face and a real voice, and run live conversation rather than turn-based exchange. Interrupt mid-sentence, trail off, talk over it, and the endpointing holds. Setup is one still photo, a persona and a voice. No rig, no capture session, no script. Two face models behind a single API. Portrait for scale, Presence for expressiveness. Both drop into Pipecat and LiveKit. Try to interrupt it. Most demos cannot survive that, and it is the fastest way to judge this one.

products.name: Sendra
products.tagline: Design emails in Figma, export HTML that works everywhere
products.summaryZh: 在Figma中设计邮件，导出随处可用的HTML
products.descriptionZh: Sendra是一款Figma插件，能将你的邮件设计转换为干净、响应式的HTML，可在Gmail、Outlook、Apple Mail及所有主流收件箱中正常渲染。选择你已设计的任意画框，无需组件库，无需重新构建。在移动端可逐元素控制堆叠、间距和尺寸，并支持深色模式覆盖。每条渲染规则均经过真实设备验证，而非预览工具。Sendra托管你的图片，并将测试邮件发送至你的收件箱，让你在发布前看到真实效果。
products.description: Sendra is a Figma plugin that turns your email designs into clean, responsive HTML that renders in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and every major inbox. Select any frame you've already designed. No component library, nothing to rebuild. Per-element control over stacking, spacing and sizing on mobile, plus dark mode overrides. Every rendering rule is checked against real devices, not preview tools. Sendra hosts your images and sends a test to your inbox, so you see the real thing before shipping.

products.name: The Million Sad Ducks
products.tagline: $1 makes one of them permanently happy
products.summaryZh: $1让其中一个永远快乐
products.descriptionZh: 免费平移和缩放整个世界。支付1美元，一只鸭子将永久幸福，获得你给它起的名字，并收到一份荒谬官方的鸭子幸福证书（PDF格式）。六个池塘，价格从1美元到1000美元不等，取决于你希望你的鸭子有多戏剧化。适合作为趣味礼物——给鸭子命名，证书将发送给你赠送的对象。
products.description: Pan and zoom the whole world for free. Pay $1 and one duck becomes permanently happy, takes the name you give it, and gets an absurdly official Certificate of Duck Happiness as a PDF. Six ponds from $1 to $1,000, depending on how dramatic you want your duck. Works as a silly gift — name the duck, and the certificate goes to whoever you're gifting it to.

products.name: IQ Routing
products.tagline: Trajectory-aware LLM routing that cuts agent cost
products.summaryZh: 轨迹感知的LLM路由，降低智能体成本
products.descriptionZh: IQ Routing 是一款即插即用的网关。我们对每个请求进行分类，从缓存中提供服务，并路由到通过质量门槛且能完成任务的最便宜模型。他人忽视的洞察在于：智能体是一条轨迹，而非独立调用的流。我们根据每一步在运行中的位置进行路由：对模板化内容使用廉价模型，对关键部分使用最强模型。
products.description: IQ Routing is a drop-in gateway. We classify each request, serve from cache, and route to the cheapest model that clears the quality bar and completes the task. The insight others miss: an agent is a trajectory, not a stream of independent calls. We route each step based on where it sits in the run: a cheap model on boilerplate, the strongest model on what matters.

products.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
products.tagline: The first natively multimodal model in GLM-5 series
products.summaryZh: GLM-5系列中首个原生多模态模型
products.descriptionZh: GLM-5.3-Flash是GLM-5系列中首个原生多模态模型。总参数量达320B，激活参数仅18B，在基准测试和实际工作负载中性能优于GLM-5.2，而价格仅为后者的十分之一，同时在编码和智能体基准测试中接近Claude Opus 4.8。
products.description: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

products.name: Yomi
products.tagline: A little cat who loves being read to
products.summaryZh: 一只喜欢听人读书的小猫
products.descriptionZh: Yomi是一只小猫，当孩子们大声朗读故事时，它就会得到喂食。语音识别会同步聆听，孩子们可以点击任何难词来听发音，一个简单的向导还能让他们创作自己的故事并读出来。真实故事分为三个难度级别，孩子们可以根据当天的心情选择合适的内容。不包含的内容：连续打卡、广告、账户或数据收集。没有人会在睡前失去14天的连续记录。Yomi不会教你的孩子阅读，而是给他们一个练习的理由。适合5-9岁，支持英语和芬兰语，iOS平台。
products.description: Yomi is a little cat who gets fed when kids read stories aloud. Speech recognition listens along, kids can tap any tricky word to hear it, and a simple wizard lets them make up their own stories to read back. Real stories come at three levels, so kids pick what feels right today. What's not in it: streaks, ads, accounts, or data collection. No one loses a 14-day streak at bedtime. Yomi won't teach your kid to read, it gives them a reason to practice. Ages 5–9, English & Finnish, iOS.

products.name: Kraa 2.0
products.tagline: Text editor and a publishing platform
products.summaryZh: 文本编辑器与发布平台
products.descriptionZh: 我们尝试了不可能之事。一款界面清爽无扰，却又是文本编辑利器的编辑器。附带一个发布平台。以及前所未有的语音支持。
products.description: We tried to do the impossible. A text editor with clutter-free UI while being a text-editing workhorse. With a publishing platform to go with it. And voice support like you haven't seen before.
